svg.title: AI-Driven Web Testing Triggered by a Jira Status Change
svg.desc: Animated workflow showing a Jira ticket moving to Test, n8n starting an OpenAI-powered ReAct QA agent, Playwright driving a taxi web application, and Jira receiving either a validated Done result or a failure comment with cause and screenshot before the ticket moves to To Fix.

g.text: AI-Driven Web Testing from a Jira Status Change
Move to TEST → n8n webhook → ReAct QA agent → Playwright evidence → Jira verdict
STATUS → TO FIX · DEFECT EVIDENCE ATTACHED
Comment = evidence, not a Jira status
The agent reasons about acceptance criteria, acts in a real browser, captures proof, and lets n8n update Jira with a traceable verdict.
